connector.name: Temporal Cortex Calendar MCP by billylui
connector.registryDescription: 12 deterministic calendar tools - temporal context, scheduling, availability, and booking
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package cortex-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the billylui account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
env.description: Google OAuth Client ID (required for Google Calendar)

env.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
env.description: Google OAuth Client Secret (required if using Google Calendar)

env.name: GOOGLE_OAUTH_CREDENTIALS
env.description: Path to Google OAuth JSON credentials file (alternative to CLIENT_ID + SECRET)

env.name: MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID
env.description: Azure AD app ID (required for Outlook Calendar)

env.name: MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET
env.description: Azure AD client secret (required for Outlook Calendar)

env.name: TIMEZONE
env.description: IANA timezone override (e.g., America/New_York). Overrides stored config and OS detection.

env.name: WEEK_START
env.description: Week start day: 'monday' (default, ISO 8601) or 'sunday'. Overrides stored config.

env.name: TENANT_ID
env.description: UUID for tenant isolation (auto-generated if not set)

env.name: LOCK_TTL_SECS
env.description: Lock time-to-live in seconds for booking safety

env.name: OAUTH_REDIRECT_PORT
env.description: Port for the local OAuth callback server

env.name: HTTP_PORT
env.description: Port for HTTP transport. When set, enables streamable HTTP mode instead of stdio.

env.name: ALLOWED_ORIGINS
env.description: Comma-separated allowed Origin headers for HTTP mode. Cross-origin requests rejected if unset.

env.name: TEMPORAL_CORTEX_TELEMETRY
env.description: Override telemetry consent: 'off' to disable, 'on' to enable anonymous usage analytics.

env.name: REDIS_URLS
env.description: Comma-separated Redis URLs. When set, activates Platform Mode with distributed locking.
